title: Sufficiency of Scripture
definition: The sufficiency of Scripture means that God has provided everything necessary for salvation, faith, and godly living through His Word.
summary: Scripture does not answer every question people may ask, but it fully reveals everything necessary for knowing God, following Christ, and living faithfully.
christFocus: The Bible is sufficient because it reveals Christ and teaches believers how to follow Him. Through Scripture, God equips His people for faithful discipleship.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Believers do not need additional revelation to complete God's message. Scripture contains all that God intends His people to know for salvation and faithful living.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People are often tempted to seek hidden knowledge, new revelations, or spiritual shortcuts. Scripture anchors believers in what God has already revealed.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Use Scripture as your primary guide for spiritual growth, decision-making, teaching, and discipleship.
